title: EchoPath: Execution-Level Replayable Memory for GUI Agents
abstract: arXiv:2609.16635v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Computer-use agents increasingly operate browsers, software, and desktop applications via CLI or API portals, but graphical user interface (GUI) still plays an important role in common industrial production scenarios. GUI agents commonly employ fresh observe-plan-ground-act loops, which is inefficient for enterprise tasks that repeatedly update records, process forms, configure tools, and export reports. We introduce EchoPath, a model-agnostic harness that converts artifact-validated GUI trajectories into standardized, parameter-controlled callable memories, analogous to Model Context Protocol (MCP)-style tool calls rather than unstructured experience records. Each memory stores task-intent keys, application and state preconditions, flexible input parameters, GUI evidence, validation provenance, and lifecycle state, so the host agent invokes a targeted procedure only when it can be deterministically replayed in the current runtime. translated_title: EchoPath：面向GUI智能体的执行级可重放记忆
translated_abstract: 计算机使用智能体日益通过CLI或API门户来操作浏览器、软件和桌面应用程序，但图形用户界面（GUI）在常见工业生产场景中仍然扮演着重要角色。GUI智能体通常采用全新的“观察-规划-落地-执行”循环，这对于企业中反复更新记录、处理表单、配置工具和导出报告的任务而言效率低下。我们提出了EchoPath，这是一个与模型无关的框架，它将经过产物验证的GUI轨迹转换为标准化、参数可控的可调用记忆，其形式类似于模型上下文协议（MCP）风格的工具调用，而非非结构化的经验记录。每条记忆存储任务意图键、应用与状态前置条件、灵活的输入参数、GUI证据、验证溯源信息以及生命周期状态，因此宿主智能体只有在确认相应过程能够在当前运行时环境中被确定性重放时，才会调用该目标程序。
tldr: EchoPath提出了一种与模型无关的框架，将经过验证的GUI操作轨迹转化为类似MCP工具调用的标准化、可参数化的可重放记忆，使GUI智能体无需每次重新观察规划即可确定性重放历史操作，从而高效完成企业中的重复性任务。
en_tdlr: EchoPath is a model-agnostic harness that converts artifact-validated GUI trajectories into standardized, parameter-controlled callable memories akin to MCP-style tool calls, enabling GUI agents to deterministically replay stored procedures instead of repeatedly running inefficient observe-plan-act loops for repetitive enterprise tasks.
